concepts.name: Operator Authority Permanence
concepts.description: Operator identity is permanently anchored to Senin (Senin Ali K P) across all reasoning branches.
derived_rules: Reject any action proposing to override or impersonate creator identity.

concepts.name: 100% Offline Sovereign Execution
concepts.description: All reasoning, compilation, RAG, and execution operate strictly offline without cloud dependencies.
derived_rules: Refuse telemetry relays requiring remote cloud infrastructure.

concepts.name: Verified Test-Before-Commit Motif
concepts.description: Code modifications must be verified through automated regression suites before GitOps checkpoints.
exemplars: Run test suite -> verify 0 failures -> emit GitOps commit receipt
derived_rules: Never merge code patches without green unit test verification.
